svg.title: A possible Two-Rail script family: comparative atlas
svg.desc: Twelve fictional stages around Carlo's original Classical script, including two alphabets, syllable cells, fused syllable pictograms and circular signs with ideograms. Identical modern keys din rento ghma and n p s r w are drawn in every hand; bare consonants have an explicit empty-nucleus sign in Harbor.

g.text: Twelve stages · the same phonetic keys · ribbons, alphabets, syllable cells and circles
